bias.tooltip: Ray origin lift off the surface, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Raise if even surfaces show dark blotches/holes.

max_distance.tooltip: Ray length, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Smaller = tighter, more local occlusion.

samples.tooltip: Rays per texel. More = smoother, slower. Raise if grainy.

cage_distance.tooltip: Surface search band, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Raise for wrong/missing patches under heavy decimation; lower if it grabs across gaps.

ignore_backfaces.tooltip: Skip high-poly surfaces facing away from the texel, so crevices/enclosed spaces don't grab the opposite wall. Disable only if the high-poly winding is inconsistent.

reference_mesh.tooltip: Optional dense pre-decimation mesh; back-projects each texel onto its true surface before sampling, removing faceted baking on coarse meshes.

ref_max_size.tooltip: Max size for the long edge of reference_video and reference_images. Resized with preserved aspect ratio and snapped to 16px.

reference_image.tooltip: Reference image injected as an in-context token (r2v, rv2v).

reference_video.tooltip: Video to insert into the source video (ads2v).

source_video.tooltip: Source video to edit or restyle (v2v, rv2v). Resized to width/height and trimmed to length.

pre_cfg.tooltip: If true, rescale the combined noise BEFORE the sampler's CFG combine, without clamping (can amplify). Matches the norm-scaled CFG used by models like Lens. Default false keeps the original post-CFG x0-space attenuate-only behavior.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

audio_prompt.tooltip: Reference audio to clone the voice from. When left unconnected the pack's built-in voice is used. Flash packs ship no built-in voice: a reference clip is required for them.

attention_mode.tooltip: Attention implementation. Backends this machine cannot run are left out of the dropdown; a saved graph that names one anyway falls back to 'sdpa'.

cfg_scale.tooltip: Block-diffusion classifier-free guidance scale. 1.0 (the upstream default) means no guidance; values above 1 trade naturalness for prompt adherence. Flash packs only; every other family ignores this.

cfg_weight.tooltip: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) weight. Controls how strongly the model adheres to the text prompt. Higher values may reduce naturalness. Ignored by Turbo-family packs: their sampler has no CFG.

device.tooltip: Device to run inference on. 'auto' follows ComfyUI's default compute device.

dtype.tooltip: Data type for model precision. 'auto' lets ComfyUI pick the best type for the target device.

exaggeration.tooltip: Controls the expressiveness and emotional intensity. Higher values lead to more exaggerated prosody.

flow_cfg_scale.tooltip: CFG scale for the mel spectrogram decoder (flow matching). Higher values increase adherence to content and timbre but may reduce naturalness.

max_new_tokens.tooltip: Maximum number of audio tokens to generate. 25 tokens ≈ 1 second. The hard limit is 4096 tokens (≈ 163 seconds).

min_p.tooltip: Sets a minimum probability threshold for nucleus sampling (Min-P). Filters out tokens with very low probability. Ignored by Turbo-family packs: their sampler has no min-p.

model_pack_name.tooltip: Select the Chatterbox voice model pack to use for generation.

normalize_loudness.tooltip: Normalise the reference clip to a consistent loudness before cloning it. Skipped with a warning when the optional 'pyloudnorm' library is not installed. Turbo-family packs only; ignored by classic and multilingual packs.

num_steps.tooltip: How many block-diffusion denoising steps to run. Fewer steps are faster but rougher; the upstream default of 10 matches the paper's best configuration. Flash packs only; every other family ignores this.

repetition_penalty.tooltip: Penalizes repeated tokens to discourage monotonous or repetitive speech. A value of 1.0 means no penalty.

seed.tooltip: Seed for random number generation. A value of 0 will use a random seed.

temperature.tooltip: Controls the randomness of the sampling process. Higher values produce more diverse speech, while lower values are more deterministic.

text.default: Hello, this is a test of Chatterbox TTS in ComfyUI.
text.tooltip: Text to be synthesized into speech.

top_k.tooltip: Limit sampling to the K most likely tokens. 1 is fully greedy, 5000 is effectively unrestricted. Turbo-family packs only (Turbo and Nano): classic, multilingual and Flash packs have no top-k and ignore this.

top_p.tooltip: Nucleus sampling (Top-P) parameter. The model samples from the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds this value.

use_watermark.tooltip: Enable or disable the audio watermark. Requires 'resemble-perth' to be installed.

target_voice_audio.tooltip: The audio file containing the target voice timbre. If not provided, the default voice from the model pack will be used.

attention_mode.tooltip: Attention implementation. Backends this machine cannot run are left out of the dropdown; a saved graph that names one anyway falls back to 'sdpa'.

chunk_method.tooltip:
Where to cut when 'max_chunk_duration' splits the source.

smart: cut as close to silence as possible near the ideal boundary. A boundary in a pause is inaudible.
fixed: cut at exact intervals. Cheaper, and the joins are more audible.

device.tooltip: Device to run inference on. 'auto' follows ComfyUI's default compute device.

dtype.tooltip: Data type for model precision. 'auto' lets ComfyUI pick the best type for the target device.

flow_cfg_scale.tooltip: CFG scale for the mel spectrogram decoder. Higher values increase adherence to the target voice but may reduce naturalness.

max_chunk_duration.tooltip:
Split source audio longer than this many seconds before converting it, and join the results afterwards. Bounds the peak memory of one conversion, which is what overflows on a long recording.

0 disables chunking and converts the clip in one pass. 5 seconds is the smallest useful value.

model_pack_name.tooltip: Select the Chatterbox voice model pack to use for conversion.

n_timesteps.tooltip: Number of diffusion steps for the flow matching process. Higher values may improve quality at the cost of speed.

refinement_passes.tooltip:
Run the conversion this many times, feeding each iteration's output back in as the next one's input.

Recommended maximum is 5; more passes cause audible distortion. Each iteration is deterministic, so raising this on a clip you already converted returns the cached result rather than redoing the work -- the cache keeps 5 iterations.

source_audio.tooltip: The audio containing the speech content to be converted.

temperature.tooltip: Controls the randomness of the initial noise. 1.0 is standard. Lower values are more deterministic.

use_watermark.tooltip: Enable or disable the audio watermark. Requires 'resemble-perth' to be installed.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

codec.tooltip: Optionally encode the video immediately. None keeps the images in tensor form; Auto uses H.264.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

pose_method.tooltip:
How the camera field-of-view is estimated (for Small/Base models only).
- cam_dec: learned from image features.
- ray_pose: derived geometrically from the model's 3D ray output.
Affects perspective correctness of the 3D output. Try both if results look distorted.

ref_view_strategy.tooltip:
Which view acts as the geometric anchor.
- saddle_balanced: the view most 'average' across all others (best general choice).
- saddle_sim_range: the view most visually distinct from the others.
- first / middle: fixed positional picks.

mode.tooltip:
mono: single view image (works with any model variant).
multiview: all images processed together for geometric consistency + camera pose (for Small/Base models only).

resize_method.tooltip:
upper_bound_resize: scale so the longest side = resolution (caps memory, default).
lower_bound_resize: scale so the shortest side = resolution (preserves more detail on tall/wide images, uses more memory).

resolution.tooltip:
Resolution the model runs at (longest side, multiple of 14).
Lower = faster / less VRAM.
Higher = more detail.
Output is upsampled back to the original size.

apply_sky_clip.tooltip: Clip sky-region depth to the 99th percentile of foreground depth before normalisation. Requires a sky key in the da3_geometry input (for Mono/Metric models only).

normalization.tooltip:
- v2_style: mean/std normalisation for perceptually balanced results (default).
- min_max: stretches the full depth range to [0, 1] for maximum contrast.
- raw: no scaling,preserves metric units for Metric model.

apply_sky_clip.tooltip: Clip sky-region depth to the 99th percentile of foreground depth before normalisation. Requires a sky key in the da3_geometry input (for Mono/Metric models only).

normalization.tooltip:
- v2_style: mean/std normalisation for perceptually balanced results (default).
- min_max: stretches the full depth range to [0, 1] for maximum contrast.
- raw: no scaling,preserves metric units for Metric model.

colored.tooltip: Apply the Turbo colormap to the sky mask.
Apply the Turbo colormap to the confidence map.

output.tooltip:
- depth: normalised greyscale depth image.
- depth_colored: depth mapped through the Turbo colormap.
- sky_mask: sky probability in [0, 1] (for Mono/Metric models only).
- confidence: normalised depth confidence (for Small/Base models only).

clamp_v_to_edge.tooltip: Project the QEM-optimal position onto the collapsed edge segment.

feature_edge_min_dihedral_deg.tooltip: Minimum dihedral angle (degree) to count an edge as a feature edge.

feature_edge_quadric_weight.tooltip: Extra quadric weight on dihedral feature edges (creases). 0 = off.

line_quadric_weight.tooltip: Per-edge line-quadric weight; preserves sharp ridges/valleys. 0 = off.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.
The number of latent images in the batch.

model_name.tooltip: Select a frame interpolation model to load. Models must be placed in the 'frame_interpolation' folder.

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

background.tooltip: Background color behind the masked subject.

grow_mask.tooltip: Grow or shrink the mask by this many pixels before cropping.

pad_factor.tooltip: Extra margin around the mask bounding box as a multiplier.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

attention_mask.tooltip: Optional pixel-space spatial mask. Controls per-region conditioning influence via self-attention, multiplied by strength.

iclora_parameters.tooltip: Optional IC-LoRA parameters from a Get IC-LoRA Parameters node. Used for adjusting guide processing as required by certain IC-LoRAs (eg. those with a reference_downscale_factor > 1). When chained, each LTXVAddGuide uses only the parameters connected to it.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to start the conditioning at. For single-frame images or videos with 1-8 frames, any frame_idx value is acceptable. For videos with 9+ frames, frame_idx must be divisible by 8, otherwise it will be rounded down to the nearest multiple of 8. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

image.tooltip: Image or video to condition the latent video on. Must be 8*n + 1 frames. If the video is not 8*n + 1 frames, it will be cropped to the nearest 8*n + 1 frames.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model used for decoding the latent.
The Audio VAE model to use for encoding.
The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

img_compression.tooltip: Amount of compression to apply on image.

stretch.tooltip: Stretch the sigmas to be in the range [terminal, 1].

terminal.tooltip: The terminal value of the sigmas after stretching.

bg_removal_name.tooltip: The model used to remove backgrounds from images

crease_angle.tooltip: Edges whose dihedral angle exceeds this value (degrees) stay hard (vertices are split). 180 = fully smooth; lower preserves sharp edges (e.g. ~30-60 for hard-surface).

apply_mask.tooltip: Set masked-out (sky / invalid) pixels to inf in points and depth so meshing culls them. Disable to keep the raw predicted geometry everywhere; the mask is still returned separately.

batch_size.tooltip: Images per inference call. Lower if you OOM on a long video / image set.

fov_x_degrees.tooltip: Horizontal field of view of the source camera. Sets the focal length used to unproject the depth map into 3D. 0 = auto-recover from the predicted points.

refine_steps.tooltip: MoGe-3 only: sparse volumetric refinement passes over the predicted depth. More passes sharpen fine detail and edges at a roughly linear cost. 0 disables refinement. Ignored by MoGe-1 / MoGe-2.

batch_index.tooltip: Which image of a batched MoGe geometry to mesh. Per-image vertex counts differ, so batches can't be stacked into a single MESH.

discontinuity_threshold.tooltip: Drop pixels whose 3x3 depth span exceeds this fraction. 0 = off.

texture.tooltip: Carry the source image through as the baseColor texture.

vae.tooltip: Reference images are ignored when no VAE is connected.

megapixels.tooltip: Target size of each reference image, preserving aspect ratio. 1.0 is about 1024 x 1024 pixels.

band.tooltip: Narrow-band width in voxel units. In UDF mode also offsets the surface.

drop_small_components.tooltip: Drop components below this fraction of the largest's face count. 0 disables.

fix_poles.tooltip: Collapse valence-3 vertex pairs (DC T-junction artifact).

precluster_max_verts.tooltip: Cap input vertex count before the field queries, inputs above this are cluster-decimated to it first. Prevents OOM on huge meshes.

project_back.tooltip: Linearly interpolate vertices toward the original surface (0 = pure DC, 1 = snapped).

resolution.tooltip: Voxel grid resolution (output density). 256 ~ 100k faces, 512 ~ 1M. For an exact face count, follow with Decimate Mesh.

drop_enclosed_components.tooltip: Drop components inside the largest's bbox that fail a point-in-mesh raycast. Disable for legitimate nested parts.

drop_inverted_components.tooltip: Drop inward-normal (negative-volume) closed components — the UDF inner shell.

qef.tooltip: QEF (Quadratic Error Function) dual-vertex placement for sharper edges.

manifold.tooltip: Manifold Dual Contouring: 1-4 dual verts/voxel for multi-sheet cases. Slower.

qef.tooltip: QEF (Quadratic Error Function) dual-vertex placement (recovers sharp features) vs edge-crossing centroid.

sign_mode.tooltip: udf: robust to messy/non-manifold input. sdf: clean single surface with QEF (Quadratic Error Function) sharp-feature recovery, but needs consistent winding.

smooth_iters.tooltip: Taubin smoothing iterations (0 = off). 2-3 cleans DC staircase-like artifacts; higher over-smooth QEF edges.

bg_removal_model.tooltip: Background removal model used to generate the mask

image.tooltip: Input image to remove the background from

camera_info.tooltip: Camera from a Load3D / Preview3D viewer or a Create Camera Info node. If none is connected, a default front view is auto-framed.

model_3d_info.tooltip: Model transform from the same Load3D / Preview3D viewer. Connect it with camera_info to match the viewer framing.

mode.tooltip: What to render. auto: texture if present, else vertex colours, else shaded clay.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from width while preserving aspect ratio.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from height while preserving aspect ratio.

multiplier.tooltip: Scale factor (e.g., 2.0 doubles size, 0.5 halves size).

longer_size.tooltip: The longer edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

shorter_size.tooltip: The shorter edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Height auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Width auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (e.g., 1.0 ≈ 1024×1024). Aspect ratio is preserved.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

match.tooltip: Resize input to match the dimensions of this reference image or mask.

multiple.tooltip: Resize so width and height are divisible by this number. Useful for latent alignment (e.g., 8 or 64).

resize_type.tooltip: Select how to resize: by exact dimensions, scale factor, matching another image, etc.

scale_method.tooltip: Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.

object_indices.tooltip: Comma-separated object indices to include (e.g. '0,2,3'). Empty = all objects.

conditioning.tooltip: Text conditioning for detecting new objects during tracking

initial_mask.tooltip: Mask(s) for the first frame to track (one per object)

detect_interval.tooltip: Run detection every N frames (1=every frame). Higher values save compute.

max_objects.tooltip: Max tracked objects. Initial masks count toward this limit. 0 uses the internal cap of 64.

camera_info.tooltip: Viewport camera information: position, look-at target, zoom, and type.

model_3d_info.tooltip: Placement of each model in the scene: position, rotation, and scale (Y-up world space).

height.tooltip: Render height of the viewport in pixels.

model_3d.tooltip: 3D model file from an upstream 3D node.

width.tooltip: Render width of the viewport in pixels.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

crf.tooltip: Lower values produce higher quality and larger files.

encoding.tooltip: Automatic preserves compatible H.264 streams. Re-encode applies custom encoding options.

crf.tooltip: Lower values produce higher quality and larger files.

encoding.tooltip: Automatic preserves compatible AV1 streams. Re-encode applies custom encoding options.

codec.tooltip: The output video codec. Auto preserves a compatible source stream. H.264 and AV1 re-encoding support SDR, HDR (HLG), and HDR PQ.

generate_audio_codes.tooltip: Enable the LLM that generates audio codes. This can be slow but will increase the quality of the generated audio. Turn this off if you are giving the model an audio reference.

image.tooltip: Preprocessed image from ImageCropToMask (pad_factor=1.0 for TRELLIS.2).

shape_latent.tooltip: The 512-resolution shape latent output from the first shape-stage KSampler.

target_resolution.tooltip: Voxel resolution of the upsampled shape. Higher = more detail, more VRAM.

start_index.tooltip: Start time in seconds, can be negative to count from the end (supports sub-seconds).

resolution.tooltip: Target atlas resolution for texel-density auto-scale (0 = fit-to-content).

segmenter.tooltip: pec: fast parallel-edge-collapse charting on GPU. adaptive: CPU, slower.

weld_distance.tooltip: Coincident-vert merge radius as a fraction of mesh extent (0 = auto). Raise to ~0.001 if you get per-triangle charts (unwelded input).

vae.tooltip: The VAE model used for decoding the latent.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to decode at a time.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to encode at a time.

shape_subdivides.tooltip: Shape information used to guide higher-detail reconstruction during decoding. Helps preserve structure consistency at higher resolutions.

video_frame_offset.tooltip: The amount of frames to seek in all the input videos. Used for generating longer videos by chunk. Connect to the video_frame_offset output of the previous node for extending a video.

ref_pad_image.tooltip: Fills the padding frames of the image conditioning with this image instead of gray, anchoring identity without pinning frames (SVI-style anti-drift padding, used by models such as ID-V2V).

render_video.tooltip: The guidance video rendered from the camera trajectory, most commonly warped point cloud renders of the input image.
